newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Mustek rises on cautionary statement.
newsitem.headline: Mustek rises on cautionary statement.

text.p: South African information technology investment firm Mustek Ltd rose on Tuesday after it posted a cautionary announcement that it was in talks on a possible deal.
The firm rose to match its year high of 15.00 rand before dropping back to 14.70 rand, a gain of 30 cents on the day.

Dealers said there was some speculation the firm may be talking to investment group Baobab about a possible link-up with Voicematrix. Baobab recently bought 25.1 percent of the specialist voice processing firm.
In February Baobab said it would distribute its entire interest in Mustek to its shareholders by way of a renounceable share offer.
Baobab shares were up 100 cents to 40.00 rand.
